head_commit.message:
Document and enforce worktree-based development (#21)

- AGENTS.md Working style: work in a worktree, default outside the repo at ../worktrees/<branch-slug>
- AGENTS.md Repo conventions: keep the main checkout clean and retire worktrees with git worktree remove
- .gitignore: add .worktrees/ as a safety net for agents that use the in-repo path
- scripts/review.sh: refuse to run from main outside REVIEW_MODE=docs and point agents at the worktree add command
- tests/test_readme.py: assert the new AGENTS.md guidance and the .worktrees/ ignore
- tests/test_app.py: assert the review.sh guard blocks main in full mode and allows it in docs mode, using a stubbed git binary to keep the test self-contained

Co-authored-by: opencode <opencode@local>

feat: add Hermes usage adapter (#14)

* feat: add Hermes usage adapter

* refactor: split dashboard app modules

* Address PR 14 data correctness and tool cards

* fix: address PR review findings

* fix: ignore unknown Hermes zero cost accounting

* fix: mark incomplete cache pricing partial

* fix: address dashboard UI follow-ups

* fix: clarify api-equivalent cost estimates

* test: add cost breakdown aggregate and tooltip coverage

* feat: rank models and days by effective tokens including cache

Introduce tokens_effective_total = tokens_total + cache_read + cache_write
as the unified ranking metric for /api/models and the daily chart, so
high-cache models surface consistently in both views. Adds a shared
dashboard.token_metrics helper used by app.py, dashboard/daily.py,
dashboard/simulation.py, and dashboard/sources.py (Codex, Hermes
adapters). AGENTS.md now notes the uv miniconda PATH fallback.

- chart subtitle now states "Daily volume includes cached input (top N models by effective volume)"
- overview Total Tokens card keeps canonical non-cache + output total; subtitle calls out the ranking/effective split
- model table "Non-cache Input" renamed to "Input" with tightened tooltip; cache read remains a separate column
- update template guard in test_dashboard_template_uses_button_based_accessible_controls to assert the new aria-label

* Tighten model table subtitle to match canonical vs effective split

Replace dense model table subtitle with the same canonical/effective language used in the overview card and chart subtitle. No behavior change. Updates the matching template guard in test_dashboard_template_uses_button_based_accessible_controls.
